stories.title: Two suggestion reasons tie: the date gaps come first
stories.recipe: two cheques of 3,000.00 and 1,000.00 paid six days after the book, and two unreferenced payments of the same amounts paid the day they were booked or the day after: two groups of suggestions with equal impact and members, so the reason order decides: the date gaps first. The pairs accepted as a group, the date gaps rejected as a group

stories.title: Two exception reasons tie: the direction conflict comes first
stories.recipe: a 1,500.00 transfer the book records as a receipt under its reference, and a 1,500.00 transfer the book records as 1,400.00 under its own: two exceptions with equal impact and members, so the reason order decides, against the signature's alphabetical order: the direction conflict first. The conflict rejected on its own

stories.title: A date gap counted from the movement date, whatever its value date
stories.recipe: three cheques each paid five days after the book; their value dates are two, five and zero days after the book: the gap is counted from the movement date, as the matcher counts it, so one group; accepted as a group

stories.title: Arabic: forty-five suggestions over three pages
stories.recipe: thirty unreferenced withdrawals and fifteen unreferenced deposits, each with its entry, over three pages of an Arabic statement in Arabic-Indic digits; both groups accepted

stories.title: A statement missing a page has no queue
stories.recipe: three suggestions planted, but the statement is pages 1 and 3 of 3

stories.title: Exceptions rejected as a group, two undone, the two rejected again
stories.recipe: four supplier transfers the book records for more under their references; rejected as a group; two undone; the group, now those two, rejected again

stories.title: One suggestion accepted alone, then its group
stories.recipe: four unreferenced deposits; the accountant accepts one, then the group, which is the other three

stories.title: A corrected cashbook after a group reject refuses the session
stories.recipe: three customer remittances the book records for less under their references, rejected as a group; then the cashbook is replaced by a corrected copy with one more receipt

stories.title: Every reason, exceptions first, each by its impact
stories.recipe: exceptions of four reasons: 800.00 received as 790.00 (impact 800.00), one 330.00 withdrawal for two 330.00 entries (660.00), a 250.00 cheque paid twice (500.00), a 120.00 card settlement booked as a refund (120.00); and suggestions: two deposits credited seven days after the receipt (9,000.00 and 500.00) and three unreferenced payments (7,000.00 the largest); no decision

stories.title: A cheque booked twice, twice over: one group
stories.recipe: two cheques each recorded twice in the book and paid once by the bank; rejected as a group

stories.title: Ambiguous deposits rejected as a group
stories.recipe: two pairs of equal unreferenced deposits, each pair within the window of one receipt: two ambiguous cases of one shape; rejected as a group

stories.title: Date gaps of two lengths and two directions: three groups
stories.recipe: cheques paid four days after the book (two), a deposit credited four days after (one), and cheques paid eight days after (two): three groups; the eight-day cheques accepted

stories.title: Nothing to decide
stories.recipe: eight movements recorded on both sides under their references

stories.title: Dollars: suggestions accepted as a group
stories.recipe: a dollar account: three unreferenced payments, each with its entry; accepted as a group

stories.title: Arabic: exceptions rejected and suggestions accepted, by group
stories.recipe: an Arabic statement in Latin digits: two supplier payments the book records 1.50 short under their references, rejected as a group; three unreferenced deposits accepted as a group

stories.title: Equal impacts inside a group keep case number order
stories.recipe: unreferenced payments of 4,500.00 on the 4th, 13th and 23rd and of 1,200.00 on the 8th, each with its entry: the three of 4,500.00 first, in case number order, then the one of 1,200.00 numbered between them; accepted as a group

stories.title: A group of one offers nothing; its neighbour is accepted
stories.recipe: one unreferenced deposit with its receipt, a group of one with the larger impact, and three unreferenced payments; the payments accepted as a group; the deposit offers no group decision

stories.title: Direction conflicts rejected as a group
stories.recipe: three card settlements the book records as refunds received under their references; rejected as a group

stories.title: A rejected case is out of the group; undone, it is back alone
stories.recipe: three unreferenced payments; the accountant rejects one, accepts the group, which is the other two, then undoes the rejection: that case is back in the queue alone

stories.title: One halala of difference before a million
stories.recipe: a 50.00 charge the book records as 50.01 under its reference, and a 1,000,000.00 unreferenced payment with its entry: the halala comes first
